title: Disjoint coordinate embeddings
statement: For natural numbers $a,b$, every $i\in\{0,\ldots,a-1\}$ and $j\in\{0,\ldots,b-1\}$ have distinct images in $\{0,\ldots,a+b-1\}$ under the embeddings of the first and second coordinate blocks, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: An index $i$ among the first $a$ coordinates
An index $j$ among the next $b$ coordinates
replaced: For every left coordinate among the first $a$ tapes and every right coordinate among the following $b$ tapes of a disjoint bank, the two embedded tape indices are distinct.
